# AI-related paths: the official list (constitution, Principle III).
# A pull request that changes any file matching a path below needs a passing
# AI test run before it can merge. Changes to this file need the project
# owner's approval (see .github/CODEOWNERS).
# Format: one path pattern per line. "**" means "everything inside this folder".
# Lines starting with "#" are comments.

# The AI clients (the answer AI and the grader)
src/lib/ai/**

# Prompts (the instructions given to the AIs)
src/lib/prompts/**

# Model choice (which AI models are used)
src/config/models.ts

# Label handling (getting, saving, and searching FDA labels)
src/lib/labels/**

# The daily label update check and the label download scripts (label handling)
netlify/functions/label-check.ts
scripts/labels-fetch.ts
scripts/labels-check.ts
# The script that loads saved labels into the database (label handling)
scripts/seed-labels.ts

# The database setup files (the label tables, the question log and test-run
# tables, and the function that looks up a drug's current label)
supabase/migrations/**

# The scripts that build the word and name lists the checks use (the English
# word list, the other-drug name list, and the common first-name list)
scripts/build-english-words.ts
scripts/build-drug-names.ts
scripts/build-first-names.ts

# The personal-details scrubber (masks names, emails, phone numbers)
src/lib/scrub/**

# The emergency checks
src/lib/emergency/**

# The text matching the emergency checks use (typos, capitals)
src/lib/text/match.ts

# The order of the question steps (emergency first, scrub before any AI)
src/lib/pipeline/ask.ts

# The language check (decides if a question is cleaned and logged, or logged with no text)
src/lib/pipeline/language.ts
# The English word list the language check uses for short questions
src/lib/pipeline/english-words.json

# The reply for each answer type the AI gives (normal, not covered, refusal backstop)
src/lib/pipeline/answer-type.ts

# Answer checks (word count, reading level, citations, dosing numbers)
src/lib/checks/**

# Refusal rules (dosing, comparisons, other drugs)
src/lib/refusals/**

# The GitHub workflows (the automatic checks: fast-tests, ai-tests, ai-gate,
# release). Changing them could switch off or weaken the checks themselves.
.github/workflows/**

# The script that runs the ai-gate check on every pull request
scripts/ai-gate.ts

# The code that decides if ai-gate and the release check pass or fail
src/lib/ci/**

# The release check (decides if a release is allowed)
scripts/release-check.ts

# The AI test tier: the answer key and its loader, the grader calibration set,
# and the test runner. Changing them could let unchecked tests in or weaken
# what counts as a passing AI test run.
tests/ai/**

# The stand-in AI that tests use to prove the AI was or wasn't called (emergency
# tests rely on it)
tests/helpers/fake-ai.ts

# The stand-in that keeps fast tests from reaching the real AI (any fast test that
# tries to create a real AI client stops with an error)
tests/fast/stubs/no-ai-client.ts

# This list itself
.github/ai-related-paths.txt
